editorial.name: Secfi
editorial.descriptionZh: 服务科技公司员工的股权理财顾问平台官网，主张 Things are just different when you have equity。它把上市前股权变现、二次出售、非追索融资和财富管理分开讲，另配六个行权与税负计算器。
editorial.takeawayZh: 看股权理财站怎么用六个计算器把税务讲成人话
editorial.noteZh: 最顶上一条深色横幅写 Introducing Maeve. AI built for your equity.，右侧灰底 Try it now 按钮。导航是 For Employees、For Executives、For Investors、Tools、Resources，外加一枚带 NEW 角标的 Maeve，右侧 Login 与黑色 Get started。首屏左侧是衬线大标题 Things are just different when you have equity，其中 you have equity 用浅色斜体强调；正文写 Secfi delivers liquidity and wealth management services to help employees and shareholders of innovative companies achieve their financial goals.，下面一枚 Get started 按钮。右侧是一张两个背影站在葡萄园前的照片，左下角写 Trusted by employees of some of the best companies，配 Canva、Coinbase、Databricks、Google 等字标。往下 Your financial peace of mind is our priority 与 Leave the calculations to us 两节铺垫，Tools 一栏并排列出 Stock Option Tax Calculator、Stock Options Exit Calculator、AMT Calculator、Exercise Timing Planner、Equity Planner、Equity Compensation 六个计算器，每个配一句 Learn more。
editorial.pricing: unknown（首页只给 Get started 与 Login，计算器与产品档位未在首页标价）

reasons.statement: 这是 Secfi 这家股权理财顾问公司的官网，导航按 For Employees、For Executives、For Investors 三类客户分组，转化入口是 Get started 与 Login。
归 product-company-sites 而非 research-quality-tools：六个计算器只是一组引流工具页（/tools/...），主体仍是顾问服务与销售线索。
Maeve 是站内单独开出一条路径的新产品线，导航里挂 NEW 角标，路径为 /maeve。
